material.description: Shed path (room.rs:286-315) defers only order drains (SHED_ORDER_CAP=0) and leaves c.sim.tick() unchanged: 200-tick 1us run overruns=4414 and still rising. shed-log-line cannot be probed: the --ticks harness serves no HTTP (connection refused), so no orders queue and tick_shed never fires. Needs an order-injection path for the headless harness, and an owner decision on which sim pass is non-essential to defer.
material.subject: Blocker: shed-log-line unprobed; tick-overrun acceptance not met by existing shed path
